newsitem.title: USA: Amtran CEO Stanley Pace resigns.
newsitem.headline: Amtran CEO Stanley Pace resigns.

text.p: Amtran Inc., holding company for American Trans Air Inc., said Wednesday that Stanley Pace resigned as president and chief executive.
Amtran's board will appoint a search committee, which will seek a replacement, the company said.
In the interim, Amtran will be managed by Chief Operating Officer Jim Hlavacek, Chief Financial Officer Ken Wolff and Senior Vice President Dalen Thomas, the company said.
Amtran, based in Indianapolis, operates 45 aircraft, including Boeing 727s, Boeing 757s and Lockheed L1011s, it said.

Amtran hired Pace as president and CEO in August after he led a team of consultants that had worked with the company. George Mikelsons, who had been CEO, remains chairman of the airline's parent firm.
The company was not immediately available for further comment.
Amtran's stock fell 25 cents to $9.25 early on Nasdaq.
